roadmap.goal: Remediate tri-review findings: token-storage security, provider data-loss bugs, concurrency semantics, iCloud spec conformance, OAuth port relocation, and release readiness across storage-bridge packages

steps.name: Expand provider contract suite
steps.description: Extend describeProviderContract with special-character keys, disconnected-operation, expectedRevision, error-taxonomy, ConflictError-payload, and pagination/5xx scenarios; remove per-package harness hacks so unmodified providers run the shared suite.
criteria: Contract suite covers keys containing apostrophe, space, slash, colon, unicode, and emoji; every provider round-trips each.
Data operations before connect reject with NotConnectedError uniformly across all providers under test.
Write with expectedRevision against a non-existent key rejects with ConflictError uniformly across providers.
Every observed rejection is instanceof SettingsStoreError carrying a code; ConflictError payload exposes the logical key.
Mocks emulate pagination page boundaries and 5xx responses; per-package harness hacks and `null as any` casts are removed.
steps.implementation_notes:
- Enforcement precedes all fixes: Phase 02 lands against this suite (decisions.md: 'Why the full 4-wave solution').
- Encodes the single disconnected-op policy (NotConnectedError), the D2 expectation (expectedRevision on missing key = ConflictError), and the logical-key conflict payload asserted by 02-05.
- Deletes: icloud monkey-patching (icloud-contract.test.ts:17-28), onedrive auto-connect Proxy, drive/dropbox logged-out auth mocks, `null as any`.
- RED mechanism: new target-behavior scenarios land as per-provider skipped/expected-failure scaffolds; existing green scenarios stay green. Remediation steps own unskipping (02-01 keys/errors, 02-02 conflict semantics, 02-03 pagination, 02-04 pre-connect, 02-05 conflict payload, 02-06 error taxonomy, 02-08 iCloud lifecycle).
- Gate: suite red only on scaffolded target-behavior scenarios; no provider modification in this step.

criteria: Apostrophe, space, slash, colon, unicode, emoji keys round-trip through put/get with identical data and no duplicate remote files.

- Error swallow at :112 returns null on query failure; must become coded rejection.
- Exact-name disambiguation lives in the shared file-backed base (file-backed-document-provider.ts:32-34).

steps.description: Corrupted remote payloads surface as coded SettingsStoreError with cause instead of raw SyntaxError; token-endpoint transport failures are distinguishable from genuine 401/403 auth failures; DocumentNotFoundError is removed as dead taxonomy.
